mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( user_id, email, password, name, gender, height, weight, age, special_note, activity_level, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{age}, #{specialNote}, #{activityLevel}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, age = #{age}, special_note = #{specialNote}, activity_level = #{activityLevel} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND password = #{userPassword}
